== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and [[Darth Vader (Errata)]] articles. Columns are Original and Decipher Errata only. Glossary 2.0. Appendix A rephrases the TIE clause in parentheses and is not a separate PC Errata column. Do not add Unlimited, Japanese, foil, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
